title: Never reduces quality or test coverage
statement: No change Retrospect proposes may lower coverage, remove or weaken tests, or lower mutation score.

criteria.given: line or branch coverage before and after a change
criteria.then: a drop of more than 0.1 points fails

criteria.given: test counts before and after a change
criteria.then: fewer tests fails unless the PR declares that many exact duplicates

criteria.given: a diff that skips a test or removes an assertion in a test file
criteria.then: each offending line fails with its file and text

criteria.given: mutation scores before and after a change
criteria.then: a lower score fails; an unmeasured change is noted, not failed

criteria.given: a faster change that fails any guardrail
criteria.then: the verdict is reject, listing the failed guardrails
